text: The workflow begins in the Input Definition phase with the dataset input, which is fed directly into dataset preprocessing.
Within Dataset Preprocessing, initial feature selection and data preprocessing are carried out on the incoming dataset.
The processed data is then partitioned into training and validation splits.
Meta-features characterizing the dataset are computed to guide the subsequent modeling steps.
In the Algorithm Selection phase, a meta-learning module selects promising candidate algorithms informed by retrieved knowledge.
Hyper-parameter tuning is then performed using Bayesian optimization to identify optimal parameter settings.
The framework computes the final evaluation output and sends performance metrics back to update the knowledge base.
The centralized Knowledge Base accumulates learned insights, allowing past configurations to be retrieved for future tasks.
